eas_text: A civil authority has issued A FIRE WARNING for the following counties or areas: Inyo, CA; at 1:43 PM on SEP 4, 2026 Effective until 1:43 PM SEP 5, 2026. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: ICSO, EVACUATION WARNING, prepare to evacuate. There is an active fire in the area of U.S. Hyw 395 between Division Creek and Aberdeen. Unknown duration.
